Name: Witchy Decorations for Content Patcher
Author: jenf1
Description:
Disclaimer: The original mod was made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ManaKirel/about-me]ManaKirel[/url] which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1515]here[/url]. The author has stated they are no longer modding and their assets may be used as part of a new mod with credit.


This mod converts Witchy Decorations to Content Patcher, adding 24 magic-themed items as craftables, all of which are available to craft immediately.

I have included an i18n with the install which contains names and descriptions of each item. [b][u]You do not need to ask me if you can translate, the answer is yes![/u][/b] In fact, I encourage it! All you need to do is send me the translated .json file and I will include it with this mod with credit to the translator!


Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Witchy Decorations into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Credit goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ManaKirel/about-me]ManaKirel[/url] for the original mod.
